_comment: Atomic action instructions for the block stacking task.
One fixed instruction per action (seen == unseen), matching the behaviour tree output.
Actions that are not listed here fall back to `_default.json`.

pick.schema: {A} is the block being picked up, {a} is the arm that picks it up

place.schema: {A} is the block being placed, {B} is where it is placed, {a} is the arm that places it
